E1-1_heatmap.aggregation_note: Pending user approval per AGENTS.md #3: switch token-span aggregation from .sum(dim=-1) to .mean(dim=-1) with per-tag relative normalization (min~max) and turbo colormap option.

E2-1_stableflow.method: True single-block bypass (0..27) to compute block vitality/delta bar chart and Top-3 vital vs 3 safe-to-skip comparison.

E2-2_block_contribution.method: Cont^(l) block ranking + causal verification using each target's neutral_sub (assert_strict_token_alignment on T5 tokenizer; fall back to direct_effect Logit Knockout when @artist token lengths differ).

E3-0_block_third_knockout.method: Per-category (style, character, outfit, prop) Early [0..8] / Mid [9..18] / Late [19..27] Logit Knockout; zero token-length constraint, 100% same base images.

E4-1_attention_sinks.method: 2-pass dynamic sink masking (AttentionSinksDiT): base vs sink-masked Before/After + pre/post sink-mass reduction bar chart.

E4-2_srp_length_consistency.notes: Per-prompt S/R/P block curves + 5-prompt mean +/- std summary chart. R->I causal attention masking is N/A on Anima (cross-attn) and deferred to MOSS-Image / Krea 2.

E4-3_m_act.notes: Multi-prompt M-Act peak-to-median activation ratios across blocks 0..27. Output Gate ablation is Krea 2 Raw only (N/A on Anima).

cross_model_notes.artist_tags_policy: @artist style tags (@ogipote, @yoneyama mai, @ciloranko, @mika pikazo) are Anima-only by default. Do NOT carry @artist tags into MOSS-Image or Krea 2 unless Step 0 pre-check empirically proves MOSS-Image follows them reliably.
cross_model_notes.moss_image_sharing: After Step 0 pre-check on the 2D character pool (tsuyuri kanao, frieren, emilia, arona, hoshino ai) and @artist convention, reuse the same characters and scenes (notably P-A4 hoshino ai <-> P-M1, P-A1 kanao, P-A2 frieren, P-A3 emilia+arona bench) with MOSS-Image's native negative prompt.
cross_model_notes.krea2_raw_sharing: Krea 2 Raw (base model only, photorealistic, empty negative prompt) excludes @artist tags. In Step 0 pre-check, test '1girl, <character> cosplay' phrasing for P-A1/P-A2/P-A4 and '2girls, ... cosplay' for P-A3; if character recognition is weak, keep the matched scene/outfit/prop/spatial layout (e.g., bench left/right with red umbrella & blue sketchbook) using photorealistic subjects.
deferred_model_specific_methods: E4-2 R->I causal attention masking (Joint-Attn MOSS-Image & Krea 2 only)
E4-3 Output Gate ablation (Krea 2 Raw only)
